questions.question: Which city does Psalm 48 exalt?
options: Mount Sinai, where the law was given
Mount Zion, the city of our God
Mount Hermon, where the dew descends
questions.answer: Mount Zion, the city of our God

questions.question: How great is the LORD, according to this psalm?
options: Greatly to be praised in the city of our God
Greatly to be sought in the day of trouble
Greatly to be feared in the assembly of the holy
Greatly to be served in the courts of his house
questions.answer: Greatly to be praised in the city of our God

questions.question: The psalm invites worshipers to walk about Zion, counting its towers.
Great is the LORD and greatly to be _____.
This is God, our God forever and ever. He will be our guide even till _____.
